content.subject: Reconciliation sprawl after $200 M raise
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob raises $200 million in Bain-led round, becomes unicorn. Rapid expansion often spawns reconciliation sprawl across teams.
We generate reconciliation entries by syncing transaction feeds from your warehouse, carrier, and accounting systems into a unified table that updates in near real time.
Worth a 15‑minute call next week?
Zamp
